source: T3 Fleet Gateway job and event ledger, usage snapshot copied from Jesse's private draft notes on 2026-11-12
notes: Events are gateway ledger records, not completed tasks, and leave out work done in T3 outside the gateway.
Events and jobs count toward the client that started the job, not necessarily the client that sent a later follow-up or answer.
Grok Bot is every bot on the shared Grok Bot connector; individual bots can't be split out.
Minions/Botons is another gateway client, used in the Minions projects since November 5. Botons is the product being built there, not a separate client in the data.
Adopted/standing jobs are existing threads the gateway tracks rather than launched; outer-loop systems can drive them too, so 87% (the two named buckets) is not an exhaustive measure.
Other/test is early pilots, QA and a few one-offs.
